findings.title: GPU pool utilization
findings.detail: NC-series training clusters power batch scoring but average forty percent utilization; queue-aware autoscale could reduce GPU minutes.

findings.title: Managed batch inferencing
findings.detail: Azure Machine Learning batch endpoints package ONNX models behind AKS inferencing pools with blue-green releases.

findings.title: Model registry RBAC
findings.detail: Workspace RBAC separates data scientists from production operators; model registry keeps immutable artifacts with signed manifests.
